comment: Documented (jsntrs-qr9): /other-operators defines the transform operator's first part as "head - evaluates to the object that is to be copied and transformed", so a head that is not an object is an error. WHICH error is not documented -- there is no error-code page (docs/behaviors.md 2.0) -- and T0410 here is the inherited signature-mismatch code, raised by the transformer's own signature before any part of the pattern or update runs.
